comparison.objective: Install one rack rail; record lays two cables in a carrier and closes every crossbar.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid long-part regrasping, spring-loaded hole insertion, telescoping, and screwdriver use versus cable routing, ordering, and repeated snap-fit closure.
comparison.success_condition: Four prongs and prescribed screws retain a level rail; record requires uncrossed, correctly ordered cables and all crossbars snapped shut.
comparison.reason: Snap/latch closure is only a shared generic primitive; the record lacks separated-post registration and load-bearing rail installation.
